name: codex-daydream
description: Turn a continuous Codex work period into a project-aware cartoon poster prompt.

interface.shortDescription: Make a project-aware cartoon poster from a work period.
interface.longDescription: Read a bounded continuous period of Codex work, even across midnight, and produce a user-guided cartoon poster prompt showing project purposes, work focus, and supported outcomes, with a dedicated creator, date, source, and repository panel.
interface.defaultPrompt: 把最近这段连续的 Codex 工作变成一张能看出项目与成果的卡通海报提示词。
